title.en: Fable 18 — The Old Man and Death

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: איש זקן עבד ביער כל היום.
sentences.en: An old man worked in the forest all day.

sentences.ar: הוא חתך עצים ושם אותם על הגב.
sentences.en: He cut wood and put it on his back.
The road home was very long.
The wood was heavy and it was hot.
In the middle of the road he stopped to rest.
He put the wood down on the ground.

sentences.ar: הוא ישב על אבן ואז נשם חזק.
sentences.en: He sat on a stone and breathed hard.
His legs hurt a great deal.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: החיים שלי קשים מדי.
sentences.en: He said: my life is too hard.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: כל יום אותו דבר.
sentences.en: He said: every day the same thing.
He said: death, come to me.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר את זה בקול גדול.
sentences.en: He said it in a loud voice.
He was tall, and dressed in black.
He said: you called me, and I came.
The old man looked at him and was very afraid.
He said: yes, I called you.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: תעזור לי להרים את העצים.
sentences.en: He said: help me to lift the wood.
